outcome.independentChallenge: Lead reviewed R1 DTO/body paths, filters, consumers, source-value preservation, and literal script callers. Three findings were fixed: repair receipt stays flat; context grade unwraps; Collector null-success fallback remains with EnsureSuccessStatusCode. The post-checkpoint F1 review later found that HttpDataCollectionWriteService still used flat core-Races payloads and raw context/profile response roots behind permissive mocks. This escaped defect supersedes the earlier acceptance for the R1 existing-consumer closure; VF003 tracks the reopened adapter-path verification. Two broad API test rewrites were restored and the test scope split to T3-A2.
